description: Three small spiral notebooks - Japan, 1973; Taipei, 1973; Taiwan, 1973; six letters between Chabot, the Chinese Consulate General, Volunteers in Asia, U.S. Embassy in Taipei, Taiwan Visitors Association, and Arthur Court Designs of San Francisco, CA concerning this trip [see also: MCA - General Correspondence - "MC to and from Caroline Bieber"]; part of an Asian American Recreation Club newspaper.
title: Japan and Taiwan trip
